author: Kometa Team
description: Offers to scan Kometa log attachments and returns private result/deletion URLs.
install_msg: Configure with `[p]logscanset url https://logscan.kometa.team`, `[p]logscanset apikey <key>`, and `[p]logscanset channels production <channel-id>`. Optional test channels use `[p]logscanset channels test <channel-id>` plus `[p]logscanset environment test`; support roles can use `[p]logscanset roles <role-id>`.
